page.layout: One printed page of text, with one marginal note in the right margin. The left margin holds only the edge of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Explicatio:
main_text.p: A. C. 1480 familia Qvattas sive Oattas Mauritaniam occupavit, & in eâ variâ fortunâ usque ad A. C. 1548 regnavit.
main_text.head: Periodus VII.
Hodiè regnant Scheriphii.Scheri-phiis.
Explicatio:
main_text.p: A.C. 1500 quidam Hamed Scheriphius, prætextu religionis, regnum Maroccanum occupavit. Cui successit frater Mahumed, qui, extincto Hamede, ultimo ex familia Oattas, totius Mauritaniæ Imperium solus obtinuit A.C. 1548.
Dissidium inter Scheriphios regnum Portugalliæ gravissimè afflixit.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Nam cum Sebastianus, Portugal-liæ Rex, sese dissidentibus Scheriphiis

page.notes: The reference mark after "Scheriphii" in the heading is a small symbol that I could not read with certainty; I have matched it to the note "à" with the letter "a" [?]. The page number is printed as "ioı"; I read it as 101 [?]. The left margin shows the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. The line "Nam cum Sebastianus..." ends the page mid-sentence, so the text continues on the next page. The catchword "im-" is read from the bottom right.
